texts.appInfoConceptBody:
inku（インク）は、短い記述から抽象的なベクターグラフィックを生み出す描画言語 DDL（Drawing Description Language）のリファレンスとなるアプリケーションです。

絵画の経験や道具が無くても、自分のイメージを形に出来ます。心に残った光景をひとつ、短く書くことが始まりで、そこから作品を作っていくことが出来ます。

texts.ddlSyntaxGuide:
指示書（DDL）簡易ガイド
指示書は、絵そのものではなく、絵を生成するための短い視覚指示です。自然文を、色・かたち・場所・動き・てざわりに分解した「演奏用の記述」として扱います。これらの文法を、DDL (Drawing Description Language)として定義しています。
1行に1つの視覚指示を書くと安定します。
基本形: 色 + 大きさ + かたち + 数 + 場所 + 動き。
例: 背景を白で埋める。
例: 赤い小さな円を右上に三個置く。
例: 青い細い線を左下から右上へ引く。
場所は「上端」「右半分」「左下から右上へ」のように具体化します。
動きや質感は「波打つ」「細かく揺れる」「クレヨン」「鉛筆」のように短く添えます。

語彙の不足を発見する
固有名詞、専門語、造語、新しい感覚表現など、既存の歳時記・正規化語彙で扱えていない候補を集めます。

同じ語が繰り返し台帳に現れる場合、その語がDDLで省略・言い換え・誤解されていないか、入力文と生成結果を人間が確認できます。

texts.appInfoConceptBody:
inku is the reference application for DDL (Drawing Description Language) — a description-based drawing language that turns a short written line into an abstract vector graphic.

No experience with drawing and no tools are required to give your image a form. Writing down one scene that stayed with you, briefly, is the beginning — and from there you build the work up.

texts.ddlSyntaxGuide:
Instructions (DDL) quick guide
The instructions are not the picture itself. They are a compact visual instruction from which the picture is performed. They turn natural language into a performable description made of color, shape, place, motion, and material. This grammar is defined as DDL (Drawing Description Language).
Use one visual instruction per line when possible.
Basic form: color + size + shape + count + place + motion.
Example: Fill the background with white.
Example: Place three small red circles at upper right.
Example: Draw a thin blue line from lower left to upper right.
Make places concrete, such as top edge, right half, or lower left to upper right.
Add motion or material briefly, such as undulating, fine tremble, crayon, or pencil.

Find vocabulary gaps
Collect candidates such as proper nouns, technical terms, coined words, and new sensory expressions that existing seasonal and normalized vocabularies do not handle.

Improve interpretation quality
When a word repeatedly appears in the ledger, a person can review the description and the resulting work to see whether it was omitted, paraphrased, or misunderstood in the DDL.

Support vocabulary decisions
Use frequency and actual contexts to decide whether a word should become formal inku vocabulary. Nothing is added automatically; the final decision remains human.

limitGroupTooltips.capability:
How much this installation can afford to put on one work. A faster machine may raise it, and this is the only family that should follow the hardware.

Measured on the development machine at engine 35: one grid mark costs about 13 KB of SVG with a pen and about 16 KB with a thick brush. Even at the default of 400, one work reaches 5-6.5 MB and takes several seconds to draw. The higher it goes, the heavier the work is to open.

The cost per mark moves by 25% with the brush, so a count is an estimate of weight, not the weight itself.
limitGroupTooltips.legibility:
The line between a number small enough to draw as stated and one too large to count, which is shown as a band instead.

A faster machine does not make an eye faster, so this family is deliberately not tied to the one above.

What should stay steady here is the look — how much ink sits in one cluster — rather than the threshold digits. Moving the band ends moves that look too.
limitGroupTooltips.safety:
Numbers that only stop a typing mistake or a runaway. Nothing here makes a drawing better.

The largest work in production carries 27 instructions (median 4), so the defaults have never bound a real one. Leave the family alone unless something is wrong.

basho:途中.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><path d="M30 62 H150" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M72 62 Q94 20 116 46" fill="none" stroke="#2c5fb8" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
basho:途中.effectJa: 線や弧の両端以外につなぐ。接ぐ位置は演奏で決まる。
basho:途中.effectEn: Connects along a line or arc, excluding both ends. The position is decided during performance.
basho:途中.exampleJa: 赤い線を置く。前の線の途中につながる小さな青い弧を置く。
basho:途中.exampleEn: Place a red line. Place a small blue arc connected partway along the previous line.

basho:隅.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><circle cx="36" cy="25" r="11" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="144" cy="67" r="11" fill="#2b2b2b" opacity="0.28"/></svg>
basho:隅.effectJa: 四隅のいずれかへ配置する。
basho:隅.effectEn: Places at one of the four corners.
basho:隅.exampleEn: Place a small circle in a corner

ugoki:置く.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><circle cx="90" cy="46" r="22" fill="#2b2b2b"/></svg>
ugoki:置く.effectJa: 指定した場所に一つ置く。
ugoki:置く.effectEn: Places one element at the given location.

ugoki:並べる.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><circle cx="55" cy="46" r="12" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="90" cy="46" r="12" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="125" cy="46" r="12" fill="#2b2b2b"/></svg>
ugoki:並べる.effectJa: 図形や組を列として並べる。
ugoki:並べる.effectEn: Lines shapes or groups up as a row.

ugoki:引く.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><path d="M22 56 C56 26 95 76 158 38" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" /></svg>
ugoki:引く.effectEn: The act of drawing a line or an arc.

ugoki:散らす.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><circle cx="42" cy="35" r="5" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="84" cy="58" r="4" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="122" cy="30" r="5" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="146" cy="65" r="3.5" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="62" cy="72" r="3.5" fill="#2b2b2b"/></svg>
ugoki:散らす.effectJa: 要素を不規則に散布する。

ugoki:埋める.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><circle cx="50" cy="28" r="5" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="80" cy="32" r="5" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="112" cy="29" r="5" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="62" cy="55" r="5" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="97" cy="58" r="5" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="132" cy="55" r="5" fill="#2b2b2b"/></svg>
ugoki:埋める.effectJa: 面や領域を密に満たす。
ugoki:埋める.effectEn: Fills a face or region densely.

ugoki:敷き詰める.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><g fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="3"><rect x="24" y="20" width="32" height="30"/><rect x="60" y="20" width="32" height="30"/><rect x="96" y="20" width="32" height="30"/><rect x="132" y="20" width="32" height="30"/><rect x="24" y="54" width="32" height="30"/><rect x="60" y="54" width="32" height="30"/><rect x="96" y="54" width="32" height="30"/><rect x="132" y="54" width="32" height="30"/></g></svg>
ugoki:敷き詰める.effectJa: 図形を規則的・反復的に配置し、明示した個数と寸法を保つ。
ugoki:敷き詰める.effectEn: Places shapes regularly and repeatedly, preserving stated count and size.

jun:交互に.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><circle cx="28" cy="46" r="8" fill="#c9362d"/><path d="M20 54 L36 38" stroke="#2c5fb8" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M51 50 Q58 32 65 50" fill="none" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="90" cy="46" r="8" fill="#c9362d"/><path d="M82 54 L98 38" stroke="#2c5fb8" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M115 50 Q122 32 129 50" fill="none" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="154" cy="46" r="8" fill="#c9362d"/><path d="M146 54 L162 38" stroke="#2c5fb8" stroke-width="3"/></svg>
jun:交互に.effectJa: 二つの色や図形、組などを交互に繰り返す。組は一つとして数える。
jun:交互に.effectEn: Alternates two colors, shapes, or groups. Each group counts as one.
jun:交互に.exampleJa: 赤い円と青い線の組を、灰の弧と交互に5つ並べる。
jun:交互に.exampleEn: Line up five, alternating a group of a red circle and a blue line with a gray arc.

jun:順に.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><circle cx="27" cy="46" r="7" fill="#c9362d"/><path d="M40 53 L48 39" stroke="#2c5fb8" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M54 50 Q61 32 68 50" fill="none" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="78" cy="46" r="7" fill="#c9362d"/><path d="M91 53 L99 39" stroke="#2c5fb8" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M105 50 Q112 32 119 50" fill="none" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="129" cy="46" r="7" fill="#c9362d"/><path d="M142 53 L150 39" stroke="#2c5fb8" stroke-width="3"/></svg>
jun:順に.effectJa: 記述した色や図形、組などの順を保って繰り返す。
jun:順に.effectEn: Repeats colors, shapes, or groups in the written order.
jun:順に.exampleJa: 赤い円・青い線・灰の弧の順に繰り返して、八つ並べる。
jun:順に.exampleEn: Line up eight, repeating a red circle, a blue line, and a gray arc in order.

wariai:縦長.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><ellipse cx="90" cy="46" rx="20" ry="34" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="5"/></svg>
wariai:縦長.effectJa: 縦方向に長い比率にする。
wariai:縦長.effectEn: Makes the proportion long in the vertical direction.

wariai:横長.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><ellipse cx="90" cy="46" rx="42" ry="18" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="5"/></svg>
wariai:横長.effectJa: 横方向に長い比率にする。
wariai:横長.effectEn: Makes the proportion long in the horizontal direction.

wariai:全幅.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><path d="M14 46 H166" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
wariai:全幅.effectJa: 画面幅いっぱいに広げる。
wariai:全幅.effectEn: Spreads across the full width of the frame.

wariai:半幅.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><path d="M45 46 H135" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M14 72 H166" stroke="#d7d1c4" stroke-width="2"/></svg>
wariai:半幅.effectJa: 画面の半分程度の幅にする。
wariai:半幅.effectEn: Sets the width to about half the frame.

wariai:半円.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><path d="M50 60 A40 40 0 0 1 130 60" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

wariai:上弦.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><path d="M90 18 A28 28 0 0 1 90 74" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
wariai:上弦.effectJa: 右に膨らむ180度の開弧として扱う。
wariai:上弦.effectEn: Read as a 180-degree open arc bulging to the right.

wariai:下弦.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 180 92" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="180" height="92" rx="6" fill="#fffdf8"/><path d="M90 18 A28 28 0 0 0 90 74" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
wariai:下弦.effectJa: 左に膨らむ180度の開弧として扱う。
wariai:下弦.effectEn: Read as a 180-degree open arc bulging to the left.
